dependencies.EC161: construction/proposed_pr_source.py (metadata and optional exact changed-file count)
dependencies.EC162: construction/proposed_pr_identity.py (exact prior pin contract, immutable identity and OID drift check)
dependencies.required_prior: Complete previous ces.proposed_pr_identity.v1 JSON with a valid pin and fingerprint, <=64KiB
dependencies.files_page_reads: 1..30 (bounded) only if the first metadata observation matches the prior pin
dependencies.provider_count_consistency: post-read changed-files count and quality must equal pre-read count and quality

github.changed_files_count: EC161 GitHub metadata changed_files int; null/missing is not complete
github.pagination: Validated Link relation on fixed endpoint; never follow arbitrary header URL
github.hard_provider_limit: GitHub returns at most 3000 file entries; at or beyond 3000 never classify complete
github.line_stats: additions/deletions/changes must be nonnegative ints, changes = additions + deletions

gitlab.choice: Uses current list-diffs endpoint, NOT deprecated /changes or raw_diffs
gitlab.changed_files_count: EC161 MR metadata changes_count exact decimal string or unknown/empty/1000+
gitlab.pagination: Validate X-Next-Page, X-Page, X-Per-Page, X-Total and same-endpoint Link if present
gitlab.statuses: added/removed/renamed/modified derived from mutually consistent new_file/deleted_file/renamed_file flags
gitlab.line_stats: null; /diffs does not provide additions/deletions as separate numeric fields
gitlab.response_limitation: GitLab /diffs JSON includes diff strings even when caller only wants paths; discard them in-memory, never emit or save; no opt-in patch return

security.credentials: CES_GITHUB_TOKEN or CES_GITLAB_TOKEN via runtime environment; never bundled or sent to arbitrary URLs
security.requests: HTTPS GET only; TLS verification, proxy inheritance disabled, no redirects/retries
security.file_path: exact relative POSIX metadata, NFC UTF-8 <=1024 bytes, <=128 components, <=255 bytes/component; reject traversal, absolute/Windows aliases, controls and ambiguous casefold duplicates

coverage.complete_only_when: exact Provider-reported file count equals all safe, unique file records AND deterministic pagination terminated AND EC162 pin matched before/after AND count unchanged AND below GitHub's 3000 cap AND available pagination total agrees
coverage.synthetic_result: May show COMPLETE as an in-fixture path-coverage shape only, but top-level status remains partial/2 and synthetic=true
incomplete_when: pagination end with fewer entries than exact Provider count
coverage.unknown_when: Provider change count missing or async not populated
coverage.unavailable_when: metadata pin drift, count changed, wrong path, duplicate paths/casefold collision, malformed pagination/payload/status/stat, token/permission/read failure; discard all files

result.live_success_meaning: Complete read-only PATH LIST within bounded metadata claims, not stable diff snapshot, patch content, provider authorization, merger, delivery, identity attestation, or local write permission
result.status_partial_meaning: Known partial/unknown coverage or any synthetic payload, never silently an empty verified list
result.status_unavailable_meaning: Reject path acquisition and suppress all path metadata

out_of_scope.EC165: provider diff version/snapshot, atomic pagination and robust consistency semantics
